chat_messages_delete_due_idx.name: chat_messages_delete_due_idx
chat_messages_delete_due_idx.where: "chat_messages"."deleted_at" is null and "chat_messages"."delete_error" is null and "chat_messages"."delete_at" is not null

message_templates_kind_shape.name: message_templates_kind_shape
message_templates_kind_shape.value: ("message_templates"."kind" = 'reminder' and not "message_templates"."at_expiry") or ("message_templates"."kind" = 'trigger' and "message_templates"."segment" in ('A', 'B') and "message_templates"."day" between 2 and 30)

payment_receipts_business_msg_uidx.name: payment_receipts_business_msg_uidx
payment_receipts_business_msg_uidx.where: "payment_receipts"."business_connection_id" is not null and "payment_receipts"."telegram_message_id" is not null

scheduled_broadcast_recipients_delete_du.name: scheduled_broadcast_recipients_delete_due_idx
scheduled_broadcast_recipients_delete_du.where: "scheduled_broadcast_recipients"."sent_at" is not null and "scheduled_broadcast_recipients"."deleted_at" is null and "scheduled_broadcast_recipients"."delete_error" is null and "scheduled_broadcast_recipients"."delete_at" is not null

sent_messages_undeleted_idx.name: sent_messages_undeleted_idx
sent_messages_undeleted_idx.where: "sent_messages"."sent_at" is not null and "sent_messages"."deleted_at" is null and "sent_messages"."delete_error" is null

sent_messages_delete_due_idx.name: sent_messages_delete_due_idx
sent_messages_delete_due_idx.where: "sent_messages"."sent_at" is not null and "sent_messages"."deleted_at" is null and "sent_messages"."delete_error" is null and "sent_messages"."delete_at" is not null

videos_marks_order.name: videos_marks_order
videos_marks_order.value:
"videos"."duration" > 0
        AND ("videos"."intro_end_sec" IS NULL OR ("videos"."intro_end_sec" >= 0 AND "videos"."intro_end_sec" < COALESCE("videos"."course_start_sec", "videos"."price_sec", "videos"."duration")))
        AND ("videos"."course_start_sec" IS NULL OR "videos"."course_start_sec" > 0)
        AND ("videos"."course_start_sec" IS NULL OR "videos"."price_sec" IS NULL OR "videos"."course_start_sec" < "videos"."price_sec")
        AND ("videos"."price_sec" IS NULL OR "videos"."price_sec" < "videos"."duration")
        AND ("videos"."unlock_sec" IS NULL OR ("videos"."unlock_sec" > 0 AND "videos"."unlock_sec" < "videos"."duration"))
